1 × DGX Spark, GB10 (128 GB unified memory); BF16

Knowledgator's released GLiClass v4 Edge (knowledgator/gliclass-v4-edge at 885af1a), a zero-shot classifier fine-tuned from DeBERTa-v3-large (supervised training, reinforcement learning, then a calibrator). Its card serves it as a library pipeline (gliclass) and maps a decision request onto it: the passage is the text, the instructions the prompt, each option a label, and a softmax over the calibrated label scores. It ran on our hardware (one DGX Spark), one request at a time, through our HTTP server (servers/gliclass_server.py) with that mapping and gliclass 0.1.22, in BF16, text only; a request over 16,384 tokens (the card's limit) is refused, never cut. Its card lists English only.
